subject: RE: Mutual Action Plan (MAP) — final sign-off and go-live date
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft and next steps (post-call recap)

Jordan — great to meet today. Thanks for the productive discovery call. Per our conversation, attached is the first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (ACME_MAP_DRAFT_v1.xlsx) that lays out milestones, owners, and target dates. Highlights and asks below:

- High-level milestones:
  • Procurement & SOW sign (owner: Sonia Patel) — target: 2026-06-25
  • Security review & SOC2 evidence handoff (owner: David Nguyen) — target: 2026-06-18
  • Integration & test deployment (owner: ACME Eng team) — target: 2026-06-28
  • Go-live (Prod) — target: 2026-07-01

- Dependencies: legal review of SOW, SOC2 evidence exchange, VPN/network provisioning for Private deployment.
- Success criteria (as we discussed): serving SLA <100ms p95, key endpoint latency under 200ms for 2k RPM, sample eval pass rate >= 92% on the provided prompt set.

Next steps:
1) Can you confirm the internal owners you want mapped to each milestone (I've pre-filled Sonia and David)?
2) Confirm target go-live date and any blackout windows in July.
3) I'll iterate the MAP to include responsibilities and deliverables; Marissa will scope the SOW changes.

Attachments: ACME_MAP_DRAFT_v1.xlsx

Thanks — I’ll follow up with an updated MAP after your notes.

—
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0197
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>

Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft and next steps (post-call recap)

Thanks Camila — appreciate the quick turnaround and clear MAP. A few notes from our side: 

- Owners: Sonia will own procurement/SOW, David will own security, and I will own integration scheduling. I added a column in your draft for "ACME owner" (see inline comments).
- Target close: Procurement + legal sign by 2026-06-25 is tight but doable; legal needs the SOW by EOD 6/5 to hit that.
- Dependencies: we need a SOC2 attestation or the specific evidence items you can share (logs, retention policy) by 6/12. David — can you confirm?

Also, two follow-ups:
1) Can Redwood provide a sample instance run (test tokens) against our dev dataset for latency verification?
2) We prefer a Private deployment in our AWS account — will need a runbook for network setup.

Looping in Sonia and David for confirmation.

- ACME_MAP_v2.xlsx (milestones refined, responsibilities mapped, deliverables column added)
- SOW_DRAFT_v1.pdf (Marissa added the installation and support language for a Private deployment)

Key changes:
- Legal/SOW deadline moved to 2026-06-05 to meet procurement target (please confirm Sonia).
- Security evidence items listed explicitly (log retention, access controls, SOC2 artifact list). David — please flag anything missing.
- Added Redwood action: provide a one-day test run in your dev account for latency verification (Ben will coordinate).

Action items assigned:
- Sonia: confirm SOW redlines by 6/5
- David: confirm SOC2 evidence list by 6/8
- Ben (Redwood SE): schedule dev test run (target 6/10)
- Marissa: finalize SOW language and pricing appendix

Attachments: ACME_MAP_v2.xlsx, SOW_DRAFT_v1.pdf

Let me know if you’d like a quick 20-min alignment call before legal review.

—

Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Updated MAP v2 — dev test run and deployment window

Camila / Marissa — FYI I ran the dev test setup with ACME’s dev account yesterday. Notes:
- Baseline latency (sample workload) averaged 85ms p95; CPU/GPU utilization looks healthy for the requested config.
- Network setup requires a single outbound rule for our control plane and an IP allowlist — Dev network team needs the IP blocks (I'll send separately).

Marissa — can you confirm in SOW that we’ll allow a one-day pilot with restricted token quotas prior to full capacity? That is a procurement ask from ACME.

Jordan — once you confirm the network window (dates), we can lock the pilot and then schedule the production cutover.

—

- David: security checklist is complete for the items you requested; attaching our completed checklist (ACME_security_checklist.pdf).

2) DocuSign envelope for SOW/SLA (legal requests a single envelope)
